skill_yaml:
skill: push_to_goal
phases:
- id: approach_1
  type: approach
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  parameters:
    approach_height:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.3
- id: contact_1
  type: contact
  generator: impedance_motion
  control: force_threshold_switch
  termination: force_exceeded
  parameters:
    speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.005
      - 0.05
- id: push_1
  type: push
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  parameters:
    push_distance:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.02
      - 0.2
- id: retract_1
  type: retract
  generator: arc_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  parameters:
    speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.01
      - 0.1
